data.body:
Final debug report for adab-9d5a-7043-42d2 / pathworky-unrivaled-firefly.

Problem: Gerrit Verified Gate could finish CI successfully and then fail the whole run in the final cast step when Gerrit rejected `gerrit review <change>,<patchset>` with `fatal: change is closed` after the change was abandoned/merged mid-run.

Proven root cause: the final Verified cast used `lfreleng-actions/gerrit-review-action` as an opaque step, so any nonzero SSH/Gerrit return code, including the terminal/unvoteable closed-change race, became a red GitHub Actions step. Representative proof: run 33580445347 normalized to `VOTE_TYPE=success` for change 2483,7, then `gerrit review` returned `error: fatal: change is closed`; Gerrit change 2483 was ABANDONED. This violates the intended two-vote gate behavior in ADR 0020/0023: CI should vote when voteable and fail closed for genuine vote failures, but a closed change is no longer a live candidate to gate.

Defect origin: scope-of-work omission in the two-vote Verified gate feature, introduced by commit 49ad69bcd242cfa7969331fc813805432072d791 (`feat: CI as a second Gerrit gate vote (Verified) via gerrit-to-platform (epic 1fa8)`). That commit predates the trailer convention and has no `rebar-ticket:` trailer; attribution is by scope of the epic that introduced the final vote path. Close recorded `caused_by=1fa8-9db4-7c1c-48f3` and `close_class=plan_defect`.

Test: added `tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`. `test_closed_change_is_a_successful_noop` was observed RED before the fix because the helper returned Gerrit's nonzero code on `fatal: change is closed`; after the fix it passes. Mutation check reintroduced that exact defect (`return completed.returncode` for the closed-change path) under `sandbox-exec`; the closed-change test failed RED, then the fix was restored. Existing workflow contract tests were updated in `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py`; guard/baseline and env-boundary regressions were also covered.

Fix: landed Gerrit change 2525 as b6a540fdbfd1f8b7d351cc81811a7e1b9ec9db7c. The final vote step now runs trusted default-branch `scripts/cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`, preserving the observed vote message/label mapping (`success -> Verified+1`, `failure -> Verified-1`, `cancelled -> Verified-1 Code-Review-1`), validating change/patchset IDs, installing dedicated SSH key/known-hosts material with chmod 600 and cleanup, and treating only `fatal: change is closed` as an Actions notice + exit 0. Other SSH/Gerrit failures preserve their nonzero exit code.

Validation: expanded targeted suite passed (`118 passed`): workflow parity/name tests, conclusion normalization, cast helper tests, summarizer tests, triage-comment tests, predate-gate guard, subprocess env safety, and mechanism-delta parity. `make lint` passed; `make typecheck` passed. GitHub Actions run 33671869052 completed success and cast `Verified+1`; Gerrit also has `LLM-Review+1`, no unresolved comments, and change 2525 is MERGED at b6a540fdbfd1f8b7d351cc81811a7e1b9ec9db7c.

Scope/safety: no new dependency. Existing tests were strengthened/retargeted, not weakened. Caller/parity sweep found no second final Verified vote path; start-of-run clear vote remains unchanged because it is not the reported final-cast race, and the later triage comment is comment-only/continue-on-error. Prior LLM advisory about leftover known_hosts was fixed in scope with a dedicated UserKnownHostsFile cleanup.

Residual risk/prevention: none observed beyond the fixed helper cleanup advisory and the baseline/guard integration fixed in patch set 3. Replication: the original closed-change vote race is reproduced by the helper regression test and no longer reddens; the live PS3 Verified Gate completed green and voted successfully on an open change.
